description: Shell script providing compatibility wrappers for /sbin/uci, including functions for loading, setting, reverting, toggling, adding, removing, and committing UCI configuration data.

methods.name: uci_load
methods.description: Loads UCI configuration data for a specified package, exporting variables and executing a callback if defined.

methods.name: uci_set_default
methods.description: Sets default configuration for a package if not already present.

methods.name: uci_revert_state
methods.description: Reverts UCI configuration to a previous state for a package.

methods.name: uci_set_state
methods.description: Sets a specific UCI configuration option to a value in the state directory.

methods.name: uci_toggle_state
methods.description: Reverts and then sets a UCI configuration option, effectively toggling its state.

methods.name: uci_set
methods.description: Sets a UCI configuration option to a specified value.

methods.name: uci_add_list
methods.description: Adds a value to a UCI list option.

methods.name: uci_get_state
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value from the state directory.

methods.name: uci_get
methods.description: Retrieves a UCI configuration value, with optional default and state directory.

methods.name: uci_add
methods.description: Adds a new UCI configuration section or sets a type for an existing section.

methods.name: uci_remove_list
methods.description: Removes a value from a UCI list option.

methods.name: uci_commit
methods.description: Commits changes to a UCI package.
